Get Up N Ride Tuesday Ride

New Orleans, LA · Social

Get Up N Ride Tuesday Ride is a social group ride in New Orleans, LA. It rolls every Tuesday at 8:00 pm from The Art Garage (meet-up changes from time to time; check the group's social pages). Pace: social.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 8:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: social.
Check
Look at @getupnride_nola the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Get Up N Ride Tuesday Ride group ride

A three-hour Tuesday social ride through New Orleans with music and stops. Now also a bike lifestyle brand that runs tours and rentals. Check Instagram for the week's start.
